metadata.title: Hyperkähler Periods in Families of Parabolic Higgs Bundle Moduli Spaces
metadata.abstract: We consider the period map on families of parabolic Higgs bundle moduli spaces with varying parabolic weights $\alpha$ and Higgs field eigenvalues $\sigma$. We assemble the moduli spaces into a smooth family $\pi:\mathscr M\to\Lambda$ where $\Lambda$ encodes $(\alpha,\sigma)$, and define parallel transport for homology along paths in an open dense subset $\Lambda_0\subset\Lambda$. By generalizing a classical theorem of Duistermaat and Heckman, we prove that the period map is affine linear in $(\alpha,\sigma)$, with slope governed by the curvature class of a principal torus bundle over $\mathscr M$. For the four-dimensional moduli spaces of types $E_6,E_7,E_8$, we compute these classes to get explicit formulas for the period maps.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 抛物型 Higgs 模空间族的超 Kähler 周期
analysis.workSummary: 让抛物权重与 Higgs 特征值同时变化，把模空间组装为光滑族，并沿参数开稠密子集中的路径平行移动同调。
analysis.breakthrough: 周期对权重及特征值仿射线性，斜率由模空间总空间上一主环面丛的曲率类给出。四维 E₆、E₇、E₈ 型算出显式公式。
analysis.limitations: 同调比较使用开稠密参数域。摘要没有跨退化参数的延拓或整体单值性结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露使用 ChatGPT 的 Astra 6 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 帮助理解既有文献、改正排字错误并为插图编写代码。研究想法由作者提出。
